patch_description: Structural redesign around a single time-budgeted simulated-annealing engine organized as a small class with precomputed triplet index arrays. Instead of interleaving many coordinate-descent phases, the architecture is: (1) multi-seed generator, (2) one unified annealer whose move sampler can (a) move a single point, (b) jointly perturb all vertices of the smallest triangle, or (c) perturb the union of vertices of the two smallest triangles (a "hinge" move when they share a vertex, which can flip degenerate configurations single-point moves cannot escape), (3) a final deterministic hard-min polish. All moves share a fast incremental area evaluation (only triplets touching moved points are recomputed), keeping eval_time low while the hinge/group moves significantly raise min_area. Determinism via fixed RNG seed and a wall-clock budget with iteration-cap fallback.
